avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces risperidone levels and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel patient on alternative mood support strategies

avoid_supplements.name: Kava Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression and hepatotoxicity risk with risperidone
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; discuss safer alternatives with prescriber

caution_supplements.name: Ginkgo Biloba
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential additive CNS effects and minor CYP3A4 induction
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased sedation or reduced antipsychotic efficacy

caution_supplements.name: Melatonin
caution_supplements.action: Use lowest effective dose and monitor for excessive sedation

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases risperidone plasma concentrations and adverse effects
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate grapefruit products from diet during risperidone therapy

caution_foods.name: High-Fat Meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase risperidone absorption and peak concentrations
caution_foods.action: Take risperidone consistently with or without food; maintain dietary stability

caution_foods.name: Caffeine
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive CNS stimulation may counteract antipsychotic sedation
caution_foods.action: Moderate caffeine intake and monitor for agitation or sleep disturbance

monitoring_notes: Monitor for orthostatic hypotension, metabolic changes, and extrapyramidal symptoms. Assess medication adherence and antipsychotic efficacy regularly, as interactions may compromise therapeutic outcomes.
